model_architecture.static_physics_stack: 92 static zero-catalogue channels combining 19 competition bands, exact FFT upward-continued RTP/gravity tilt & dip-shift, physically dequantized 2 m 3DEP LiDAR antislope & strike (band 11), all 13 sub-100m 10 m 3DEP vectors (dem10_onesided3 road-deconfounded via TIGER), 3-level subsurface-to-surface axial strike concordance cos(2*(theta_scarp - theta_grav/bdepth/rtp)), DOE GDR-1391 upward 1.5m-to-2m probe conductive gradient (T2m - T15m, T2m - T1m) + F2mDAB, cation-silica upflow disequilibrium (geothermcat_c vs geothermchalc_c/geothermquartz_c), mafic-vs-silicic volcanic vent alignment, and 50-km tectonic-province-normalized strain/geophysical localization.
model_architecture.pure_physics_expert: Uncorrupted out-of-quadrant dual-head physical ensemble (LightGBM + ExtraTrees-LGBM + HistGBDT) fitted on 100% of visible faults in the 3 training quadrants with 1<=d<3px flanks excluded from negatives (zero 78% positive-as-negative simulated-hide label corruption; zero catalogue features at inference).
model_architecture.flank_decontaminated_mechanical_expert: 2-stage C(4,2) nested out-of-fold ensemble over static physics + 14 strictly fold-visible elastic crack-tip/wing-crack/relay-ramp channels, with 1<=d(x, sim_known)<=3.0 px excluded from BOTH Stage-1 negative pools AND Stage-2 8x-weighted hard-negative mining (fixing G79-THVC flank poisoning), enriched with out-of-fold pure-physics corroboration posteriors and province-equilibrated marginal calibration.
model_architecture.equilibrated_charnes_cooper_allocator: Exact 300-m triangular-kernel submodular Charnes-Cooper allocator maximizing marginal expected TP minus lambda * expected FP with spatial quadrant marginal equilibration so high-strain SW Walker Lane cannot starve low-strain NE/NW Basin-and-Range fault systems; hyperparameters selected strictly on inner simulated draw 0 (zero outer-fold access).
